about_the_game:
Story Synopsis

As a homebody girl obsessed with anime, daily life, and the 'extreme tug-of-war' of homework, Mengqin never imagined that her life would be completely changed by a co-branded poster blown away by the wind. That late autumn afternoon, she met a mysterious girl—Ye Mo—on the cherry blossom-lined path in the park.A first encounter over a poster, and a 'shared task' in the library became the starting point of their bond. Chatting during library shifts, the heart-racing moment of an accidental fall in the storage room, sharing a red umbrella on a rainy day, and confessing under the brilliant evening sunset.Two entirely different souls gradually draw closer amid exams, homework, club legends, and the confusion of youth.Here, there are no complicated relationships or heavy-family burdens.There is only the pure and true daily life that belongs to girls in their youth.They get punished for not memorizing English words, get caught secretly playing Go during evening study sessions, feel their hearts stir during a confession at a romantic sunset, are confused and overwhelmed by each other's brilliance, and after recognizing their feelings, run toward the stage without hesitation.When ideals collide with love, and the confusion about the future intertwines with the courage in the moment.Will they be able to run toward each other again, allowing the cherry blossoms of spring to bloom once more for the two of them?Content Highlights- 150,000-word script with multiple endings and branches- Lighthearted, everyday stories- Created by high school students, full of small details of high school lifeCharacter IntroductionMengqin
